title: He bet $3 on a jacket someone put back
move_line: Know the field well enough to see the odd result.
teaser: A 19-year-old paid about $3 for a jacket another shopper tossed back. It sold at auction for $89,600.

title: Two hours a day, for twenty years
move_line: Stay in longer than the early talent would.
teaser: Virginia Evans finished seven novels nobody published. The eighth won the 2026 Women's Prize for Fiction.
youtube_alt: Video thumbnail: Virginia Evans and twenty years of rejections before her Women's Prize win

title: He was looking for a campsite
move_line: Do not stare so hard that you miss the notice.
teaser: Joël Lapointe was looking for a campsite and found a meteor crater.
